lines.text: Bench first, then forge, then the steam workshop. Ores to parts, parts to power. Bring core.steam when you can.
Rock bites back. 'Too hard for this tool'? Upgrade to tool.pick.t2.reinforced or find a softer vein.
Pick swings breathe with your stamina—tap, rest, tap. With tool.drill.t3.steam, pulse in bursts; let the boiler catch up.
Three‑Wide Law: cut corridors three across. Hang a lamp by a door’s hinge; when it burns yellow, folk know it’s a way in.
See a glow halo on a Cave Burrower—dodge aside. A Goblin Grunt telegraphs wide—raise your guard, then crack him.
Short on coin? Sell ore.copper and ore.iron. Keep some for recipes. shard.quartz runs rare—save it for keen tools.
Make it habit: scratch a Depth‑Mark by each door in your ledger. Next shift knows where the dark starts.
First Warrant forged the truce at Claim’s Mouth. No brawls, no blades—only coin, ale, and work tallies under my roof.
Bottomless Mine? Some swear it hums a deep note. Set a mug on the bar and watch it quiver when the earth sings.
Whispers say a seam shifts by the belled tunnel. Lamps ring twice, vein slides sidewise. Follow the ringing.
